// diagnostic

E0397

`{old}` is a retired declaration spelling; write `{new}`.

What

`{old}` is a retired declaration spelling; write `{new}`.

Why

Every declaration is written `name: value`: a binding `limit: 100`, a function `area: fn(r: Float) -> Float`, a type `Point: struct`; `:=` stays the mutable binding.

Fix

Write `{new}`; `jet fix` applies this fix.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0397: tests/ui/E0397_retired_declaration_spelling.stderr.

    |      ^^^
 Why: Every declaration is written `name: value`: a binding `limit: 100`, a function `area: fn(r: Float) -> Float`, a type `Point: struct`; `:=` stays the mutable binding.
 Fix: Write `:`; `jet fix` applies this fix.
